title: Jubilant Silky American Banana Skillet
description: A silky, one-pot American dish featuring dehydrated bananas, perfect for a rajasic-friendly meal. This recipe combines the natural sweetness of bananas with the warmth of spices.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat, adding the coconut oil and ghee to melt.
Add the ground cinnamon, ground ginger, and turmeric powder to the skillet, stirring for 1 minute to combine.
Add the dehydrated bananas to the skillet, stirring gently to coat with the spice mixture.
Cook the banana mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the bananas start to soften.
Add the honey and almond milk to the skillet, stirring to combine, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has thickened and the bananas are silky.
Taste and adjust the sweetness and spice level as needed.
Serve the skillet warm, topped with chopped walnuts if desired.
Let the skillet cool slightly before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
